title: Add DM tool to record consequential improvised lore
description:
Add a constrained DM tool for promoting consequential improvised lore into campaign overlay state.

The DM should not be forced to pre-author every detail in a module, but when it introduces a consequential fact that may affect future play, it must record that fact.

Possible tool names:
- record_world_fact
- record_lore
- promote_lore

The exact name is implementation-defined, but the tool must communicate intent clearly.

The tool should require constrained fields rather than accepting arbitrary unstructured memory.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add a tool callable by the DM runtime to record campaign overlay lore.
- The tool validates required fields:
  - kind
  - subject or subjectId
  - fact text
  - truthStatus
  - source
  - scope
  - visibility
- The tool rejects or discourages decorative scene color unless it is promoted because the player interacted with it or it became consequential.
- The tool returns evidence that can be included in the mechanics/world audit for the same turn.
- Tests cover:
  - recording a rumor
  - recording observed evidence
  - recording an NPC detail
  - rejecting malformed records
  - preserving player-visible vs DM-only distinction
close_reason: Implemented campaign overlay canon, truth-statused lore recording, world_query retrieval/search, audit/prompt guidance, docs, and regression coverage.
